verified_facts.summary: Canonical repository is JakeAIGO/JakeAI with default branch main.
Model continuity implementation is isolated on feature/model-continuity-router.
Continuity state validation, handoff generation, and four regression tests executed successfully in a local runtime.
Continuity uses rolling state plus an append-only event journal so meaningful work is captured during long sessions rather than only in periodic handoff documents.
JakeAI now has a documented free-first capacity policy and provider-neutral capacity registry; circumvention is prohibited and paid expansion requires explicit owner approval.

active_work.summary: Provider-neutral continuity layer is implemented and locally tested; rolling autosave, event journaling, and free-first capacity governance are staged on the continuity branch.

next_action: Integrate recent journal events and capacity status into generated handoffs, then perform the external cross-provider acceptance test without purchasing capacity.
constraints: No additional spend beyond the existing domain cost unless explicitly approved.
Do not claim proposed, staged, pending, or unit-tested work is live or sold.
Do not bypass provider usage limits; design lawful provider-independent failover instead.
Do not include secrets, tokens, credentials, private paid-delivery URLs, proprietary prompts, or trade-secret implementation details in portable handoffs.
Preserve legal, financial, security, and consequential-action approval gates.
Near-term commercial goal remains the first real independent paid sale.
Continuity state must be updated after meaningful state-changing work rather than waiting for the end of a session.
Optimize first; use only legitimate free capacity; paid capacity requires demonstrated need and explicit owner approval.
Never evade quotas, rate limits, access controls, account restrictions, or payment requirements.
handoff_notes: The model is not the memory. The model is not the project. JakeAI owns the project state; models are interchangeable compute.
Resume from the highest-value unresolved checkpoint with less discussion and more verified execution.
The handoff should be generated from rolling state and recent journal events, not reconstructed from conversation memory.
Capacity expansion follows the free-first escalation ladder and does not authorize spending.
